qualification: Local exploratory measurements; correctness checks enforce matching output hashes. Heavy host load limits latency and startup conclusions.

hostObservation.scope: Observed during paired measurements; not a dedicated idle benchmark host.

isolatedWorkers.statistic: Median warmed per-call milliseconds; all raw samples retained
isolatedWorkers.policy: AFN tag, scale 2, half-even, per-line gross/discount/tax rounding; identical prepared inputs and output hashes
isolatedWorkers.scope: Decimal comparisons are arithmetic baselines on valid bounded data, not interchangeable public APIs. End-to-end comparison uses the same fully validated accounting API for JS and native. Fresh-process time includes the entire worker benchmark, not just startup.

alternatingSameProcess.statistic: Median of nine alternating same-process samples; preparation and calculation included; GC outside timing
